name: broken-promises-no-fatestone-or-fatebound-click-refused
notes: Broken Promises (re911j7fo4, FIRE skill, reserve 1) requires sacrificing a Fatestone item or Fatebound ally as an additional cost; the field holds only the champion (patched to a FIRE champion so the element is usable). Reserve 1 is affordable, so only the additional-cost gate refuses. Before the fix the card was announced onto the effect stack before that check refused it, stranding it there.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate Broken Promises, sacrifice a Fatestone item or Fatebound ally.

engineBug.summary: FIXED (see memory-invocation-no-floating-memory-click-refused): the additional-cost legality check ran after the card was announced.
engineBug.verification: Per-step state dump: before the fix EffectStack = [re911j7fo4], hand 2; after the fix the card stays in hand.
